svg.title: Proa and SvelteKit streaming the product grid under HTTP load
svg.desc: Proa refreshed 2026-11-11 UTC; SvelteKit retained 2026-10-21. Apple M4 Max; one worker thread or process per engine. SvelteKit response end delivers promised data and excludes browser rendering; Proa delivers resolved HTML. Proa at 250 req/s target: 250 response ends per second, response-end P50 90.9, P95 91.9 and P99 92 milliseconds, 8 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 250 req/s target: 250 response ends per second, response-end P50 90.8, P95 91 and P99 91.2 milliseconds, 200 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. Proa at 500 req/s target: 500 response ends per second, response-end P50 91.4, P95 91.7 and P99 91.9 milliseconds, 9 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 500 req/s target: 500 response ends per second, response-end P50 90.2, P95 90.5 and P99 90.7 milliseconds, 233.1 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. Proa at 1000 req/s target: 1000 response ends per second, response-end P50 91.2, P95 91.3 and P99 92.2 milliseconds, 12 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 1000 req/s target: 1000 response ends per second, response-end P50 90.4, P95 90.7 and P99 91.1 milliseconds, 261 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. Proa at 2000 req/s target: 2000 response ends per second, response-end P50 91, P95 91.3 and P99 91.6 milliseconds, 17.4 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 2000 req/s target: 2000 response ends per second, response-end P50 90.3, P95 91.9 and P99 92.9 milliseconds, 310.7 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. Proa at 3000 req/s target: 3000 response ends per second, response-end P50 90.9, P95 91.3 and P99 92.6 milliseconds, 23.1 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 3000 req/s target: 3003 response ends per second, response-end P50 91.6, P95 95.5 and P99 98.1 milliseconds, 359.3 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. Proa at 4000 req/s target: 4000 response ends per second, response-end P50 91, P95 92.2 and P99 93.5 milliseconds, 29.2 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 4000 req/s target: 2935 response ends per second, response-end P50 720.2, P95 5942 and P99 5976.9 milliseconds, 527.3 MiB peak RSS, 1186 failures across three repeats. Proa at 5000 req/s target: 4978 response ends per second, response-end P50 103.4, P95 145.4 and P99 165.4 milliseconds, 50.2 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 5000 req/s target: 2923 response ends per second, response-end P50 1868.6, P95 3474.8 and P99 4335.1 milliseconds, 555.3 MiB peak RSS, 1072 failures across three repeats. Proa at 6000 req/s target: 4478 response ends per second, response-end P50 1233.4, P95 2014.8 and P99 2166.4 milliseconds, 218.7 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats. SvelteKit at 6000 req/s target: 2986 response ends per second, response-end P50 2559.7, P95 5937.2 and P99 8527.3 milliseconds, 537.2 MiB peak RSS, 0 failures across three repeats.
svg.text: 96 cards · 8 boundaries · one worker/process per engine · medians of 3 processes
Higher is better · dashed: request-rate target
Proa: 2026-11-11 UTC. SvelteKit: 2026-10-21. Apple M4 Max; same offered rates.
SvelteKit response end delivers data; Proa delivers resolved HTML. See methodology for browser completion.
Successful-response latency includes scheduled queueing. Failures by rate remain in the source tables.
